name: Barbell Standing Calf Raise
cues: Unrack the bar onto your upper back and step onto the edge of the step
Keep your forefoot on the edge and your feet about hip width
Hold your knees nearly straight and your trunk tall
Let your heels sink below the step, then rise as high as you can

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: The motion is correct and nearly identical to 607: ankle -36 to +25, bar drift 7 mm, feet fixed. But on the reused low step camera (az -108) the near plate covers the whole head and upper back in every hero frame. The calves stay visible.
